items.description:
Steers Turfloop Plaza is the Mankweng branch of the flame-grilled burger and chicken chain Steers, confirmed through the brand's own branch locator as the restaurant trading from Turfloop Plaza. The restaurant serves Steers' signature flame-grilled burgers and chicken, together with chips and milkshakes, prepared for customers looking for a quick, flame-grilled meal rather than a sit-down dinner.

Customers can choose to eat in, collect a takeaway order, or have their meal delivered, giving students, staff and residents in the area a flexible way to get a Steers meal without needing to travel into central Polokwane. The restaurant trades from Shop E1 in Turfloop Plaza, on the corner of University Street and Houtbosdorp Road in Mankweng, and is open daily for lunch and dinner service.

Sterns is the Mall of the North branch of the long-established South African jewellery retailer, now part of The Foschini Group, confirmed through the mall's own current store directory as trading from Shop U83. The store carries jewellery ranges spanning bridal and diamond pieces through to watches and gifting items, drawing on the brand's decades of experience in the jewellery trade.

Shoppers visiting this branch can expect the same curated jewellery selection the chain is known for nationally, backed by the group's buying power and after-sales support. The store trades within Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane, open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays, making it a convenient stop for anyone shopping for an engagement ring, a gift or a special-occasion piece.

Sunglass Hut is the Mall of the North branch of the international eyewear retailer, trading from Shop U95A according to the mall's own current store directory. The store stocks fashion and performance sunglasses from a wide range of well-known eyewear brands, aimed at shoppers looking for everyday sunglasses as well as statement eyewear pieces.

As part of a retail chain with stores across the globe, the branch benefits from access to current seasonal collections and brand partnerships that a smaller independent optical store would struggle to match. The outlet trades within Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane, giving shoppers in the area a dedicated sunglasses specialist alongside the mall's other fashion and eyewear stores, suited to anyone updating their eyewear or searching for a specific brand.

Thabeng Guest House is a guest house in Bendor Park, Polokwane, offering overnight accommodation with air conditioning in the rooms and breakfast included for guests. Current booking information for the property lists it as a 1-star guest house, giving visitors a clear sense of the simple, no-frills style of stay on offer rather than a luxury lodge experience.

The guest house suits travellers who want a straightforward, comfortable base while visiting Polokwane, whether for business, a family visit or passing through the city. It is located at 19 Schalk Drive in Bendor Park, with check-in from 14:00 and check-out by 10:00, giving guests a predictable routine for arrivals and departures during their stay.

The Body Shop trades from Shop U27 in Mall of the North, as confirmed by the mall's own current store directory, selling the brand's range of body-care, skincare and cosmetic products. The range is built around natural ingredients and the retailer's long-standing stance against animal testing, a position the brand has held since it was founded.

Shoppers can browse the in-store range of lotions, scrubs, fragrances and gift sets the chain is known for, with staff on hand to help match products to a particular skin type or occasion. Weekday trading at the branch runs from 09:00 until 19:00, shortening to 09:00 until 17:00 on weekends and public holidays, making it an easy stop within the Bendor mall for shoppers picking up skincare or a gift.

items.description:
Thomas Grobler Attorneys is a law firm based in Polokwane Central, established in 1992 and still practising in the area today. The firm's current professional listing sets out a broad litigation and commercial practice, covering Magistrates', High, Criminal and Labour Court matters, together with debt collection work for clients needing to recover outstanding money.

Beyond litigation, the practice handles property law and conveyancing, commercial law matters for businesses, and estate planning and the administration of deceased estates for families working through a loved one's affairs. This combination of courtroom and transactional work lets the firm serve both individuals and businesses from a single office rather than referring clients elsewhere.

The firm is based at 14 Landdros Mare Street in Polokwane Central, a long-standing address for a practice that has been operating in the city for more than three decades.

The agency is a family-owned business established in 1994 that exports, sells and distributes a range of goods, mainly for the irrigation and construction industries. It supplies agricultural and industrial pumps, including centrifugal and peripheral pumps, submersible borehole pumps, fountain pumps and sewage and drainage pumps, alongside landscape and agricultural irrigation solutions. Its catalogue also covers piping, pipe fittings, industrial hoses, filters and purification products, JoJo tanks and garden fittings, and plastic sheeting.

The business concentrates on the agricultural and construction sectors and sells products for a number of manufacturers and importers. Its homepage describes a commitment to helping customers grow since 1994. The agency is based in Polokwane, the capital of Limpopo, and buyers looking for pumps, piping or irrigation equipment in the area can source them from here.

TopT Seshego is the Madiba Park branch of the budget-focused tile and bathroomware retailer, confirmed through the brand's own store locator as a dedicated Seshego store. The branch stocks floor and wall tiles alongside bathroom products such as basins, taps and fittings, aimed at customers planning a renovation or a new bathroom or floor.

Homeowners, renovators, builders and anyone taking on a flooring or bathroom project can browse the range in person and get guidance on matching tiles, fittings and finishes to a specific room or budget. The store trades from the Madiba Park Complex, on the corner of Nelson Mandela Drive and Madiba Park Crossing in Seshego, giving the area its own dedicated tile and bathroomware outlet rather than requiring a trip into central Polokwane.

Torga Optical's Mall of the North branch is confirmed on the brand's own branch page as a full optometry practice trading from Shop L76, on the corner of the R81 and the N1 Bypass in Bendor Ext 99. The practice offers comprehensive eye examinations, prescription spectacles and a range of advanced lens options, together with sunglasses and fashion eyewear for customers who aren't there for a prescription.

A resident optometrist and eyewear consultants work from the branch, supported by retinal imaging equipment for a closer look at eye health during consultations. The practice accepts most medical aids and processes claims digitally, so members can have cover checked and claims submitted without extra paperwork on their side.

Trading from Mall of the North in Bendor, the branch serves patients needing an eye test or new spectacles as well as shoppers after a new pair of sunglasses.

Trevor's Haven Preschool, Creche & Aftercare is a childcare centre in Bendor, Polokwane, offering preschool and creche care for young children together with an aftercare programme for children already at primary school. Current listings for the centre place it at 29 Munnik Avenue in Bendor, operating during the working week to fit around parents' daily schedules.

Families needing care for a baby, toddler or young child, or an aftercare option once the school day ends, can rely on the centre as a single point of contact rather than arranging separate providers. The centre generally operates from around 06:00 to 18:00 on weekdays, giving working parents in Bendor and the surrounding area an early-childhood and aftercare option close to home.

Inside Mall of the North in Bendor, Shop U12f is home to Truworths Elements, the beauty and cosmetics side of the Truworths retail business, as listed on the mall's own current store directory. Rather than clothing, this branch focuses on make-up, fragrance and skincare lines carried under the wider Truworths banner.

Shoppers who want to add beauty products to a Truworths shopping trip, or simply need a cosmetics stop within the mall, can visit the store without leaving the centre. Trading hours run from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays, matching the rest of the mall's retail hours and making it an easy add-on stop for shoppers already browsing Mall of the North.

Unjani Clinic Mankweng is a nurse-led primary healthcare clinic that is part of the national Unjani Clinic network, confirmed on the network's own official clinic locator as the branch serving the Mankweng area. Across the network, Unjani clinics are built around everyday primary care: health screening, treatment of minor ailments, chronic disease management, and maternal and child healthcare, delivered by qualified nurses rather than general hospital staff.

For residents of Mankweng, this clinic offers that same model locally, giving the community a nearby option for routine medical needs instead of a trip to a hospital or a larger private practice. The clinic is located at Stand No. 655, Mankweng Unit B, Mankweng, Limpopo, placing it within easy reach of patients in the surrounding area who need accessible, nurse-led primary healthcare close to home.

items.description:
The Wound Clinic is an advanced wound care practice in Polokwane, founded in 2008 to meet the growing need for post-operative and chronic wound care. Its aim is the treatment and rehabilitation of complex wounds, and it treats different types of wounds on a daily basis. Patients can be on private or public medical aid, and the clinic works with product manufacturers to keep up with the latest wound care technology.

Advanced wound care is given by trained and experienced staff who have had ongoing training with specialists over the past decade. The clinic consults a multidisciplinary team that includes general practitioners, physicians, plastic and general surgeons, orthopaedic specialists, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, podiatrists, dieticians and diabetic centres. Its staff are members of WHASA.

Services are offered at 71 Burger Street in Hospital Park, and patients can book an appointment through the website.

items.description:
Angel Feeds Polokwane supplies animal feeds, poultry medication and poultry equipment to farmers in the Polokwane area, with a particular focus on broiler production and day-old chicks. Current business listings for the company confirm this specialisation, alongside its location and trading hours in Industria.

The business serves poultry farmers and other agricultural customers who need a reliable local source for feed, medication and the equipment broiler operations depend on, rather than ordering from suppliers further afield. Being based in Industria puts it within easy reach of farmers operating in and around Polokwane.

The business trades from 41A 19th Street in Industria, Polokwane, open on weekdays and on Saturday mornings, giving farmers a convenient window to collect feed and supplies outside the standard working week.

Aphane Attorneys is a law firm based in Lebowakgomo offering civil litigation services to clients in the area. Current listings for the practice identify it specifically as the Lebowakgomo branch, giving local clients a legal practitioner they can approach for representation in civil disputes without having to travel to a larger centre.

Clients needing legal representation in a civil matter can use the practice as a local point of contact in Lebowakgomo rather than engaging a firm based further away. The firm's listed address places it within the Lebowakgomo area, making it accessible to residents and businesses who need civil litigation support close to home, in a part of Limpopo where legal services of this kind are not always easy to find.

items.description:
The firm describes itself as a next-generation law practice, made up of business lawyers who serve small and medium-sized enterprises as well as individuals. It provides tailored, integrated legal services across a wide range of practice areas, and says it is built to fit each client's needs rather than a standard template. Its team has over 15 years of experience.

Clients are offered cost certainty, with a reasonable and predictable price rather than billing by the hour. Meetings are arranged around each client's day, and much of the work can be completed online, by email, by telephone or by video conference. The firm builds its service around technology, which it sees as a way to improve how clients are served.

The office is in Bendor, Polokwane, and suits start-ups, growing businesses, established organisations and entrepreneurs with bigger goals.

Bendor Bayete provides luxury self-catering overnight accommodation in the upmarket suburb of Bendor, Polokwane. Its furnished, en-suite self-catering suites are aimed at family visitors, corporate guests, business executives, people relocating to the area and international travellers. Secure parking and DSTV are available, and the business offers affordable rates on its furnished suites for companies.

The accommodation is close to banks, shops, hospitals and malls, and the website lists the Mall of the North, a Medi Clinic in Polokwane, Peter Mokaba Soccer Stadium, the airport and Savannah Mall as places about five minutes away. For big sporting or school events in the Polokwane area, guests can contact the business for their self-catering needs.

BMW Polokwane is an authorised BMW dealership forming part of the Legacy Motor Group's network, selling and servicing BMW vehicles together with the BMW Motorrad motorcycle range. Legacy Motor Group's own confirmation of the dealership referenced a new-generation BMW facility announced for the site in 2023, marking a significant upgrade to the dealership's premises and customer facilities.

Customers can buy a new BMW car or motorcycle through the dealership, or bring an existing vehicle in for servicing and parts, backed by the manufacturer's dealer network and the group's wider dealership experience. The dealership trades from Baobab Gardens in Polokwane, giving Limpopo customers a dedicated BMW and BMW Motorrad outlet in the city rather than needing to travel to Gauteng for sales or servicing.

items.description:
Capricorn Veterinary Laboratories is a veterinary laboratory based in Flora Park, Polokwane, providing diagnostic and testing services to veterinary professionals and others needing laboratory support for animal health. Current directory listings confirm the practice's category and its address in Flora Park.

Veterinarians and other animal-health professionals in Limpopo can send samples to the laboratory for testing rather than relying on facilities further afield, making it a convenient local resource for the veterinary community working across the province. Because its work sits behind the scenes of animal healthcare, most of its contact is with practices and professionals rather than the public directly.

The laboratory is based at 215 Marshall Street in Flora Park, Polokwane, giving it an established, centrally located base within the city.

Cash Crusaders Paledi Mall buys second-hand goods for cash, covering everyday items such as cellphones, electronics, appliances and musical instruments, and also arranges secured short-term loans against valuables for customers who need quick access to money. Items brought in for sale or as loan security are assessed in branch before a cash offer or loan amount is agreed.

The branch forms part of the Cash Crusaders group's network of pawnbroking and second-hand retail stores, which pairs an ordinary shopfront with pawnbroking services rather than running them as two separate businesses. Loans taken out against valuables run for a standard 30-day term, giving customers a short window to repay before the item is forfeited.

Trading from Shop 66 in Paledi Mall on the R71 in Mankweng, Polokwane, the store is a convenient option both for residents turning unused goods into cash and for anyone needing a short-term loan secured against something of value, rather than an unsecured cash advance.

Crispy Fresh Takeaways serves fast food built around toasted kotas, with signature options such as the Ma'nxane, M Power, Mavuso and Gwara Gwara alongside chips, fried chicken, sandwiches and fish dishes. The menu is aimed squarely at quick, affordable meals rather than sit-down dining, with every order prepared to go.

The takeaway has built up a strong local following, reflected in a 4.8 rating from 240 votes on Restaurant Guru, and is available for delivery as well as walk-in collection, serving students and residents around the University of Limpopo area in Mankweng.

Based on University Road in Mankweng-A, Polokwane, it's a popular stop for a quick kota or a plate of fried chicken and chips between classes or on the way home.

Debonairs Pizza at Mall of the North serves its Triple-Decker and Real Deal pizza ranges for takeaway, collection and delivery, alongside the sides and extras that round out a typical order. Pizzas are made to order rather than held pre-made, and the branch takes orders in person, by phone or online for delivery.

Trading from Shop U76 in Mall of the North on the R81 in Polokwane, the branch suits individual customers and families ordering in for the evening as well as shoppers collecting a pizza while they're already browsing the centre. It's a dependable stop for a quick meal, whether diners are feeding a family at home or grabbing a slice on a shopping trip.

Exact is one of the fashion and footwear retailers trading inside Mall@Lebo in Lebowakgomo, named directly on the centre's own official store listing alongside names such as Identity, John Craig, Miladys, The Ambassador and Truworths as one of the outlets that keep shoppers dressed in current styles and brands. As part of The Foschini Group, Exact sells value-priced clothing, footwear and accessories for men and women, together with clothing and footwear for children from about 2 to 12 years old.

The store trades from Shop 14 in the mall, on the corner of the R518 and R579 outside Lebowakgomo, giving shoppers in the area a nearby option for everyday fashion and children's wear without a trip further into Polokwane. It suits families and individual shoppers looking for affordable, regularly refreshed clothing ranges close to home.

items.description:
Hi-Q Polokwane Ladine is a tyre fitting and autocare centre offering tyre replacement, wheel alignment and tyre repairs, along with tyre disposal and recycling for worn-out tyres, confirmed on Hi-Q's own official store locator for this branch. The branch forms part of the national Hi-Q tyres and autocare network, which focuses on tyre and related wheel servicing rather than general mechanical repairs.

Based on Silicon Street in Ladine, within Polokwane's Extension 17, the centre serves vehicle owners who need new tyres fitted, existing tyres balanced and aligned, or punctures repaired, as well as motorists looking to dispose of old tyres responsibly. It's a straightforward call-in option for tyre and wheel care in the Ladine area of Polokwane.

High Precision Engineering Works is an automotive and general engineering workshop handling engine repairs, fitting and turning, and welding work, alongside diesel-engine servicing for cars, trucks and other diesel-powered machinery. The workshop also takes on earthmoving-equipment repairs, including bucket, pin and bush work on excavators, loaders and similar plant equipment, putting it at the crossing point between vehicle repair and heavier agricultural or construction machinery work.

Based on Emerald Street in Futura, Polokwane, the business serves vehicle owners, farmers and operators of earthmoving and agricultural equipment who need engine, welding or engineering repairs carried out locally rather than sending machinery out of the area. It's a practical option for anyone needing fitting, turning or diesel-engine work done close to home in Polokwane.

Ingwe Waste Management is a Level 1 BBBEE, 100% Black-owned company that has been operating for over 20 years. It collects, disposes of and recycles waste in Limpopo, Gauteng, Mpumalanga and North West, with weekly or scheduled pickups, flexible rescheduling, skip bin rentals and handling for high-volume and bulk waste.

The company also handles hazardous and industrial by-products, secure collection of medical and clinical waste, and tailored waste management plans for compliance. Recyclables are separated on site and processed at an in-house recycling facility, and the company reports a recycling rate of 85% and more than 50,000 tons of waste collected. Its website also highlights eco-friendly disposal, and the business is based in Dalmada, Polokwane.

Inkmart Copiers supplies and services copiers, printers, fax machines and wide-format machines, together with duplicators, office furniture, stationery and general office consumables. The company also supplies telecommunications equipment and related services, covering most of what an office needs to keep its printing, copying and communication running day to day.

Established in 2016, the Annadale-based business has grown to supply clients across Limpopo, working mainly with commercial and educational organisations that need reliable office machinery and a steady consumables supply rather than a single once-off purchase. Based in Annadale, Polokwane, Inkmart Copiers is set up to handle both the initial equipment supply and the ongoing stationery and consumables that offices and schools need to keep operating.

Ivory Lodge is a 28-room lodge offering luxury overnight accommodation as well as bed and breakfast lodging. Traditional breakfasts are prepared daily and can be adjusted to guests' dietary requirements. The lodge also has conference facilities and offers outside catering for breakfasts, luncheons, cocktail parties and private or corporate events.

The property sits near shopping centres and the city centre but outside the daily traffic, and its website says security is a priority. Travellers heading to Zimbabwe, Kruger National Park and Botswana often use it as a stop-over, and guests can visit nearby attractions such as Magoebaskloof Rainforest, the Bakoni Malapa cultural museum, Ebenezer Dam, Debegeni Falls and the Zebediela citrus estate. The lodge describes itself as an ideally located base in the heart of Limpopo.

Key & Sound Centre offers locksmith and automotive sound services together under one roof in Moregloed, Polokwane. Locksmith work covers key cutting, ignition and lock repairs, transponder key programming and gearlocks, plus number plates made up on site, while the sound side covers the supply and installation of car audio systems.

The combination lets vehicle owners handle security, access and in-car entertainment needs in one visit, from a lost car key or a faulty ignition to upgrading a sound system before a long trip. The centre trades from Shop 18C in the Astra Building on Grobler Street in Moregloed, serving motorists across Polokwane who need locksmith, security or car-audio work done without visiting several separate specialists.

K.M. Mothupi Butchery Chisanyama is a butchery and chisanyama outlet in Zone 2, Seshego, selling fresh meat cuts alongside freshly grilled chisanyama for customers who want their meat cooked on site rather than taken home raw. The combination of butchery and grill lets customers choose a cut and have it prepared on the spot, or buy packaged cuts to cook at home themselves.

Located on Kgoro Street in Seshego-B, Polokwane, the business serves local residents looking for a quick, affordable meal of grilled meat as well as households doing their regular meat shopping, with both counter service and takeaway available for customers on the move through the week and over weekends.

Kurt Geiger is a British luxury footwear and accessories brand, and its Mall of the North outlet is confirmed on the centre's own current store directory as one of the mall's fashion retailers. The branch stocks the brand's shoe and accessory ranges, bringing a higher-end footwear option to the Polokwane shopping scene alongside the centre's other fashion stores.

Trading from Shop U23 in Mall of the North, the store serves shoppers after designer-style shoes, bags and accessories without needing to travel to Johannesburg or Pretoria for the brand. It suits customers looking for a step up from the mall's more budget-focused footwear retailers.

items.description:
Lebowa Kgomo Secondary School is a public, no-fee secondary school teaching Grades 8 to 12 under the National Senior Certificate curriculum set out in CAPS. It is classified as a Quintile 3 school, placing its fee status and state funding level within South Africa's public school quintile system, and it takes day scholars only rather than offering boarding facilities on site.

School records put its 2025 enrolment at 394 learners taught by 13 educators, identified under EMIS number 923260376 within the Capricorn South education district. Based in Lebowa Kgomo, Lebowakgomo, the school serves secondary-level learners from the surrounding community working toward their National Senior Certificate.

Lekana Shooting Academy & Gun Shop provides firearm competency and training services together with shooting-related retail in Polokwane Central. The academy appears on an accredited provider list for firearm competency training, the qualification legally required under South Africa's Firearms Control Act before a firearm licence can be issued, which sets it apart from a shop that only sells.

Alongside training, the business supplies shooting-sport related goods and equipment for licensed owners and hunters. Based on Landdros Mare Street in Polokwane Central, it serves customers working through the legally required competency process as well as shooting-sport customers buying ammunition, accessories or other related goods, combining the training and retail sides of the firearms trade under one roof.

Levubu Cottages offers self-catering accommodation from five fully equipped units, operating since 2023 in Penina Park, Polokwane. Each unit comes with air conditioning, DStv, Netflix and Wi-Fi, and guests benefit from daily housekeeping during their stay along with secure on-site parking for their vehicles.

The self-catering format gives guests their own kitchen facilities to prepare meals rather than relying on an on-site restaurant, suiting business travellers on extended stays as well as families and leisure guests who prefer the flexibility of cooking for themselves. Based at 9 Levubu Avenue in Penina Park, the property is a short-stay option for visitors to Polokwane looking for a self-contained, serviced place to stay.

Matrix Warehouse Computers Polokwane sells computers, laptops, peripherals, printers, scanners, software, networking equipment and storage devices, along with other general IT products, from its Polokwane Central store. The Matrix Warehouse group it trades under was founded in 2001, giving the Polokwane branch the backing of a long-running national IT retail chain.

The store serves home users buying a new laptop or printer, as well as businesses sourcing networking equipment, storage or software for their operations, and handles everything from single-item purchases to larger IT equipment needs. Based on Schoeman Street in Polokwane, it's a local option for computer hardware and accessories without ordering online and waiting for delivery.

items.description:
Motel Villa Africa offers lodge-style guest accommodation in air-conditioned rooms and apartments, each with its own kitchen for guests who want to prepare their own meals during their stay. Free Wi-Fi and on-site parking are available, and the property is set up with families in mind alongside other short-stay visitors.

The self-catering kitchens make it a practical option for longer stays or for guests travelling with children who prefer not to eat out for every meal, while the parking and Wi-Fi cover the basics business and leisure travellers typically need. Based in Polokwane Central, the property serves as a straightforward short-stay base for families, business travellers and leisure guests visiting the city.

Mr Price Sport stocks sporting apparel, footwear and outdoor equipment across the main sport codes, trading as the dedicated sport and outdoor arm of the wider Mr Price Group. Mr Price's own description of the format covers value-priced performance wear, running shoes and general sporting equipment aimed at everyday fitness and sport rather than specialist competition gear.

The Mall of the North is among the shopping centres that lists Mr Price Sport specifically as one of its performance-wear and running-shoe retailers, distinguishing it from the group's general clothing stores in the same centre. Trading from Shop U78 in Mall of the North, it serves shoppers looking for sportswear, running gear, fitness clothing and general sporting goods in Polokwane.
